title: Inferno — Boards of Canada ★★★★
text: very ambitious venture into the eerie. it doesn't have as clear a visual association to materialize the world like Tomorrows Harvest, but its definitely similar in that it feels like a product of a world parallel to ours. each song feels like a revision to the image conjured by the previous, but it didnt end as formed as i would hope. its not quite easy listening, and it isnt quite a cinematic epic soundscape. which i think is exactly where it was supposed to land, i just dont feel especially grabbed the way i am with some of their other work.
